arxiv-2104-02851.title: Interpreting A Pre-trained Model Is A Key For Model Architecture Optimization: A Case Study On Wav2Vec 2.0
arxiv-2104-02851.creator: Liu Chen, Meysam Asgari
arxiv-2104-02851.description: Abstract A deep Transformer model with good evaluation score does not mean each subnetwork (a.k.a transformer block) learns reasonable representation. Diagnosing abnormal representation and avoiding it can contribute to achieving a better evaluation score. We propose an innovative perspective for analyzing attention patterns: summarize block-level patterns and assume abnormal patterns contribute negative influence. We leverage Wav2Vec 2.

arxiv-2204-07150.title: FREDA: Flexible Relation Extraction Data Annotation DOI: xx.xxx/xxx_x ISBN: 978-1-4503-9517-5/23/03 Conference: ACM SAC Conference; March 27 –April 2, 2023; Tallinn, Estonia 4 Price: 15.00 CCS: Computing methodologies Information extraction
arxiv-2204-07150.creator: Michael Strobl, Amine Trabelsi, Osmar Zaïane
arxiv-2204-07150.description: Abstract . To effectively train accurate Relation Extraction models, sufficient and properly labeled data is required. Adequately labeled data is difficult to obtain and annotating such data is a tricky undertaking. Previous works have shown that either accuracy has to be sacrificed or the task is extremely time-consuming, if done accurately.

arxiv-2207-01775.title: Revisiting sterile neutrino dark matter in gauged U ​ ( 1 ) B − L U(1)_{B-L} model Preprint: UME-PP-021 Preprint: EPHOU-22-013
arxiv-2207-01775.creator: Shintaro Eijima, Osamu Seto, Takashi Shimomura
arxiv-2207-01775.description: Abstract We reexamine sterile neutrino dark matter in gauged U ​ ( 1 ) B − L U(1)_{B-L} model. Improvements have been made by tracing and careful evaluation of the evolution of the number densities of sterile neutrinos N N and extra neutral gauge bosons Z ′ Z^{\prime} .

arxiv-2305-17546.title: Electronic and vibrational excitations on the surface of the three-dimensional topological insulator Bi 2 Te 3-x Se x ( x = 0 , 2 , 3 x=0,2,3 )
arxiv-2305-17546.creator: A. Lee, H.-H. Kung, Xueyun Wang, S.-W. Cheong, G. Blumberg
arxiv-2305-17546.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by A. Lee, H.-H. Kung, Xueyun Wang, S.-W. Cheong, G. Blumberg. We study surface states in the three-dimensional topological insulators Bi 2 Te 3-x Se x ( x = 0 , 2 , 3 x=0,2,3 ) by polarization resolved resonant Raman spectroscopy. By tracking the spectral intensity of the surface phonon modes with respect to the incident photon energy, we show that the surface phonons are qualitatively similar to their bulk counterparts.

arxiv-2308-00518.title: Understanding the effect of Prandtl number on momentum and scalar mixing rates in neutral and stably stratified flows using gradient field dynamics
arxiv-2308-00518.creator: Andrew D. Bragg 1, Stephen M. de Bruyn Kops 2
arxiv-2308-00518.description: Abstract Recently, direct numerical simulations (DNS) of stably stratified turbulence have shown that as the Prandtl number ( P ​ r Pr ) is increased from 1 to 7, the mean turbulent potential energy dissipation rate (TPE-DR) drops dramatically, while the mean turbulent kinetic energy dissipation rate (TKE-DR) increases significantly.

arxiv-2409-10148.creator: Akash HOSSAIN
arxiv-2409-10148.description: Abstract . In their article about distality in valued fields, Aschenbrenner, Chernikov, Gehret and Ziegler proved resplendent Ax-Kochen-Ershov principles for quantifier elimination in pure short exact sequences of Abelian structures. arxiv-2503-05893.title: Zero-shot Medical Event Prediction Using a Generative Pre-trained Transformer on Electronic Health Records
arxiv-2503-05893.creator: Ekaterina Redekop, Zichen Wang, Rushikesh Kulkarni, Mara Pleasure, Aaron Chin, Hamid Reza Hassanzadeh, Brian L. Hill, Melika Emami, William Speier, Corey W. Arnold
arxiv-2503-05893.description: Abstract Objectives: Longitudinal data in electronic health records (EHRs) represent an individual‘s clinical history through a sequence of codified concepts, including diagnoses, procedures, medications, and laboratory tests. Foundational models, such as generative pre-trained transformers (GPT), can leverage this data to predict future events. While fine-tuning of these models enhances task-specific performance, it is costly, complex, and unsustainable for every target.

arxiv-2508-19316.title: Sycophancy as compositions of Atomic Psychometric Traits
arxiv-2508-19316.creator: Shreyans Jain, Alexandra Yost, Amirali Abdullah
arxiv-2508-19316.description: Abstract Sycophancy is a key behavioral risk in LLMs, yet is often treated as an isolated failure mode that occurs via a single causal mechanism. We instead propose modeling it as geometric and causal compositions of psychometric traits such as emotionality, openness, and agreeableness - similar to factor decomposition in psychometrics. Using Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) ( Panickssery et al.

arxiv-2510-12329.title: Generative Diffusion Model DiffCrysGen Discovers Rare Earth-Free Magnetic Materials
arxiv-2510-12329.creator: Sourav Mal, Nehad Ahmed, Subhankar Mishra, Prasenjit Sen
arxiv-2510-12329.description: Abstract Efficient exploration of the vast chemical space is a fundamental challenge in materials discovery, particularly for designing functional inorganic crystalline materials with targeted properties. Diffusion-based generative models have emerged as a powerful route, but most existing approaches require domain-specific constraints and separate diffusion processes for atom types, atomic positions, and lattice parameters, adding complexity and limiting efficiency.

arxiv-2511-16438.title: ESGBench: A Benchmark for Explainable ESG Question Answering DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: AI and Data Science for Digital Finance Workshop at ACM ICAIF 2025; November 15, 2025; Singapore ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2025/11
arxiv-2511-16438.creator: Sherine George, Nithish Saji
arxiv-2511-16438.description: Abstract . Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) disclosures have become central to financial decision-making, yet sustainability reports remain lengthy, heterogeneous, and difficult to analyze at scale. Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise in extracting insights from these reports, but the field lacks standardized benchmarks to evaluate system accuracy, grounding, and explainability.

arxiv-2602-02685.title: Expert-Data Alignment Governs Generation Quality in Decentralized Diffusion Models
arxiv-2602-02685.creator: Marcos Villagra, Bidhan Roy, Raihan Seraj, Zhiying Jiang
arxiv-2602-02685.description: Abstract Decentralized Diffusion Models (DDMs) route denoising through experts trained independently on disjoint data clusters, which can strongly disagree in their predictions. What governs the quality of generations in such systems? We present the first ever systematic investigation of this question. A priori, the expectation is that minimizing denoising trajectory sensitivity—minimizing how perturbations amplify during sampling—should govern generation quality.

pmc-10609581.title: Occurrence of Neonatal Necrotizing Enterocolitis in Premature Neonates and Gut Microbiota: A Case–Control Prospective Multicenter Study
pmc-10609581.creator: Julio Aires, Zehra Esra Ilhan, Lancelot Nicolas, Laurent Ferraris, Johanne Delannoy, Maxime Bredel, Anne Chauvire-Drouard, Frédéric Barbut, Jean-Christophe Rozé, Patricia Lepage, Marie-José Butel, ClosNEC Study Group
pmc-10609581.description: Background: Necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) is still one of the leading causes of neonatal death. The present study reports the data from a French case–control prospective multicenter study. Methods: A total of 146 preterm neonates (PNs) with or without NEC were included. Bacterial 16S rRNA gene sequencing was performed on stool samples (n = 103).

pmc-12647660.title: First imported cases of MPXV Clade Ib from Goma, Democratic Republic of the Congo
pmc-12647660.creator: Daniel Mukadi-Bamuleka, Eddy Kinganda-Lusamaki, Noella Mulopo-Mukanya, Adrienne Amuri-Aziza, Áine O’Toole, Sydney Merritt, Brigitte Modadra-Madakpa, Guy Mutombo-Ndongala, Emmanuel Hasivirwe Vakaniaki, Cris Kacita, Gaston Lubambo Maboko, Jean-Claude Makangara-Cigolo, Michel Ngimba, Emmanuel Lokilo-Lo
pmc-12647660.description: BackgroundThe ongoing mpox outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) resulted in >71,000 suspected cases from 01 January 2024 to 02 February 2025. Clade Ib mpox virus (MPXV) emergence has heightened public health concern due to observed sustained human-human transmission and spread to multiple non-endemic East African countries.

pmc-12707717.title: A case of rapidly progressive cervical primary spinal epidural lymphoma
pmc-12707717.creator: Shota Ito, Naoki Ichikawa, Takahiro Miyazaki, Akari Noro, Masato Shiba, Tomohiro Araki, Waka Harada, Masaki Mizuno
pmc-12707717.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Primary spinal epidural lymphoma (PSEL) is rare, accounting for just 0.1–6.5% of all extranodal lymphomas and 9% of all primary spinal epidural tumors. They are mostly located in the thoracic spine, with only occasional cervical spine involvement. Here, a 74-year-old male presented with a cervical epidural diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) that was successfully managed with an emergent surgical decompression.Case Description: A 74-year-old male presented with the acute onset of quadriparesis.

pmc-13221988.title: A comparative analysis of three distinct rehydrating solutions for addressing liver tissue desiccation resulting from dehydration failure
pmc-13221988.creator: Weiping Shi, Guangming Fu, Hailei Shi, Huiyang Qi, Haiyang Fu
pmc-13221988.description: BackgroundThe tissue dehydration process is an important step in pathology specimen preparation. Dehydration failure, caused by equipment malfunction, incorrect program settings, or operator error, is a recognized problem in laboratory practice and can compromise the quality of hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) slides, thereby hindering subsequent pathological diagnosis. Common ad hoc responses include stepwise rehydration or short-term immersion in various buffers.
